note: Ratio of mean radiance, later year ÷ earlier year, per 5′ cell (≈ 9 km) from EOG VNL V2 annual average_masked (via Zenodo 17294744). Frames: '2012–2024' = 2012→2024, '2021–2024' = 2021→2024. Shown where either year reaches 0.5 nW/cm²/sr; 0.1 is added to both years before dividing, so newly lit cells saturate at the top. Clamped to 0.1–10 (1 = no change). The 2012 composite starts in April 2012, when VIIRS data begin.
